Q6113.reason: Arson requires malice, meaning intent or reckless disregard of an obvious risk, and merely forgetting the stove is ordinary negligence, so he is not guilty.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle has two phases, diastole (relaxation and filling) and systole (contraction).

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because of its hydrogen-bonded crystalline framework, so pressure favors the liquid and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
